text:
Mina K: heads-up: opened PR #7814 — adaptive scheduler changes + a small warmup tweak. this touched request routing where tiny tails were slipping past the SLO. can reviewers take a look?

Alex P: looking now. can you paste the bench you ran? was this on canary or local? :eyes: 

Mina K: ran on canary (region-eu) with the slo-sample harness. small synthetic mix: 60% short, 30% medium, 10% long. results attached below.

deploy-bot: CI check passed for PR #7814 (unit tests, lint).

Mina K: benchmark snapshot:
```
SLO-sample run 2026-03-15 16:07:23
 - p50 latency: 48.2 ms
 - p95 latency: 210.3 ms
 - p99 latency: 540.8 ms
 - mean tokens/sec: 312.4
 - avg GPU mem per worker: 6.1 GB
 - tail requests dropped (fallback count): 4
```

Jamie L: those p99 numbers look better than the baseline? what was baseline for the same harness?

Mina K: baseline (canary before change):
```
 - p50: 50.0 ms
 - p95: 225.7 ms
 - p99: 612.2 ms
 - tokens/sec: 298.1
 - avg GPU mem: 5.9 GB
```
so p99 improved ~70 ms, throughput +4.8%, mem +200MB avg.

Alex P: nice. any regression for long-seq tail when load spikes? canary run with a 30s spike?

Mina K: i ran a quick spike test (added 2x QPS for 30s at t=120s). observed a transient p99 bump to 780ms but recovered within 8s; fallback count briefly hit 12 then back to 0. logs show the scheduler briefly moved a few requests to a lower-priority queue while KV warmups were in flight.

Jamie L: can you paste the exact command you used to run the harness so I can reproduce locally?

Mina K: sure:
```
./harness run --profile slo-sample --region eu --duration 300 --spike 120:2x --output /tmp/bench-7814.log
```

Taylor R: quick review comments on PR: 1) add a comment explaining the fallback heuristic, 2) add a small unit test for the priority queue boundary, 3) consider limiting the backoff window to 5s instead of 10s (that was causing the 8s recovery).

Mina K: thanks — i'll add tests and tweak the backoff to 5s. pinging @Alex P and @Jamie L for approvals after i push.

Alex P: i'll approve once the unit test and comment are in. also add a short note in the changelog: "adaptive scheduler: reduced tail latency under mixed workloads".

Jamie L: +1 to Alex's conditions. one more ask: can we add a small histogram dump to the canary run artifacts so SRE can track p99 over time?

Mina K: good idea. i'll attach histogram json in artifacts. should be done in the next push.

deploy-bot: deployment canary scheduled for 2026-03-16 02:30 UTC (post-merge) if all approvals complete.

Mina K: pushed tests and comments, added histogram artifact. bumping this for approval. :rocket:

Alex P: reviewing the new tests now.

Jamie L: approved.

Alex P: approved. merging after CI green. :+1:

deploy-bot: PR #7814 merged into main by Alex P. canary deploy initiated.

Taylor R: great work — monitor the canary dashboards for the next 2 hours. i'll watch the SLO alerts channel. :eyes: 

Mina K: thanks team! will post canary summary in ~30m.
